Picks the page on the server (the host's own address for a direct endpoint; for a tunnelled one a tunnel on the desktop app or this plugin's proxy in a browser) and gives back a grant the app draws it from. The tab never picks the address or the certificate rule.

>

  responses={{"200":{"description":"{ grant, url }"},"400":{"description":"Invalid request","or the endpoint opens through Termix.":null},"401":{"description":"Not signed in."},"403":{"description":"Host not found or access denied."},"409":{"description":"A direct endpoint on the same site as Termix would get its login cookie."},"501":{"description":"This Termix version can't show pages for plugin tabs."}}}
>
